QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_30

question.text: A Cat III AIF commits Rs. 50 crore on Jan 1, 2019. Liquidation distribution on Dec 31, 2023 = Rs. 70 crore. Gross IRR (worst case, no fees)?

explanation.text: The Logic: 50 × (1 + IRR)^5 = 70. Solving: IRR ≈ 6.96%. The Trap: 12%/18.13% are best-case figures; 3.48% is Net IRR worst case. Cross-Exam Context: Matches worst-case Gross IRR computation in workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use XIRR for irregular timing; IRR is fine for annual equal intervals.
